title: Bill of Sale Requirements by US State (2026)
description:
A source-linked dataset covering, for all 50 US states and the District of Columbia: whether a bill of sale is needed to title a vehicle bought from a private seller, whether the bill of sale or title signatures must be notarised, the state's official bill of sale form (name, number and link), and odometer disclosure rules. Every row links to official government sources and records how each notarisation value was confirmed. Checked 23 November 2026.

Published by Robot Lawyer (https://robotlawyer.co). Create a bill of sale: https://robotlawyer.co/documents/bill-of-sale
